diff --git a/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts b/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts

--- a/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
+++ b/src/api/common/utils/EntityUtils.ts
@@ -131,6 +131,30 @@ export function haveSameId(entity1: SomeEntity, entity2: SomeEntity): boolean {
 	return isSameId(entity1._id, entity2._id)
 }
 
+/**
+ * Removes technical fields from a new entity and all nested objects.
+ * The resulting entity is unsuitable for update operations.
+ */
+export function removeTechnicalFields<E extends SomeEntity>(entity: E): void {
+	const technicalFieldPrefixes = ["_finalEncrypted", "_defaultEncrypted", "_errors"]
+
+	const removeFrom = (value: unknown): void => {
+		if (value === null || typeof value !== "object") {
+			return
+		}
+
+		for (const key of Object.keys(value)) {
+			if (technicalFieldPrefixes.some((prefix) => key.startsWith(prefix))) {
+				delete (value as Record<string, unknown>)[key]
+			} else {
+				removeFrom((value as Record<string, unknown>)[key])
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	removeFrom(entity)
+}
+
 export function containsId(ids: ReadonlyArray<Id | IdTuple>, id: Id | IdTuple): boolean {
 	return ids.find((idInArray) => isSameId(idInArray, id)) != null
 }
